value.title: Prefetch traverses form bindings without widening destructive lookup readers
value.statement: Only GISApplication.fillMissingLookupTablesForCollectorForm and LayerFillService.UnzipForm.execute use fillLookupTableIdsForPrefetch. Traverse typed combobox.attributes.ngw_id in root array, recursive type=tabs pages[].elements and both declared root tabs orientation arrays. Keep Android getLong, malformed-present errors and -1. Return normalized IDs once in first appearance order per call. Old public fillLookupTableIds body and entire NGWVectorLayerUI deletion file/two calls remain byte-exact, including duplicate/error/legacy scope. Never widen destructive readers through the new walker. No global cache uniqueness, installed same-hash repair, retry/durability/snapshot completeness or account backup policy is established; native import/cache/Save and malformed inactive layouts are separate bounds.
